title: Create a lesson plan and quiz for a standard
summary: Build a 45-minute grade 7 lesson on unit rates, with a short quiz and answer key.
deliverable: A lesson plan, quiz and answer key
brief: Create a 45-minute grade 7 lesson on unit rates with fractions (standard 7.RP.A.1), plus a 5-question quiz with an answer key.
sources:
Standard 7.RP.A.1: compute unit rates associated with ratios of fractions, including ratios of lengths, areas and other quantities measured in like or different units.
Department guide: lessons follow warm-up, worked example, guided practice, independent practice, exit quiz.
Class profile: 28 students; 4 need reading support, so word problems use short sentences.
draftA:
Warm-up (5 min): simplify 3/4 ÷ 1/2.
Worked example (10 min): a walker covers 3/4 mile in 1/2 hour. Unit rate = (3/4) ÷ (1/2) = 3/2 = 1.5 miles per hour.
Guided practice (10 min), independent practice (15 min), exit quiz (5 min).
Quiz Q3: Paint covers 2/3 of a wall with 1/4 gallon. How many walls per gallon? Answer key: 2/3 × 1/4 = 1/6 wall per gallon.
draftB:
Warm-up (5 min): what does 'per' mean? Three everyday rates.
Worked example (10 min): 1/2 cup of sugar for 1/3 batch: (1/2) ÷ (1/3) = 3/2 cups per batch.
Guided practice in pairs (10 min); independent practice with short sentences (15 min); exit quiz (5 min).
Quiz Q2: A snail moves 1/8 metre in 1/4 minute. Speed? Answer key: (1/8) ÷ (1/4) = 1/2 metre per minute.
reviewOfA:
D-A1 · P0 · Wrong answer key
  Quiz Q3 asks for walls per gallon, so the rate is (2/3) ÷ (1/4) = 8/3, about 2.67 walls per gallon. The key multiplies instead of dividing and gives 1/6, so it would mark correct students wrong.
D-A2 · P1 · Reading support
  Two word problems run past 30 words; the class profile asks for short sentences.
reviewOfB:
D-B1 · P1 · Thin warm-up
  The warm-up does not practise dividing fractions, which the worked example needs.
Strengths: every answer in the key is correct; word problems are short.
synthesis:
Kept from A: the walking example and the fraction-division warm-up.
Kept from B: pair work, short-sentence problems and the snail question.
Fixed D-A1: Q3 key is now (2/3) ÷ (1/4) = 8/3 ≈ 2.67 walls per gallon, with the working shown.
Fixed D-A2 and D-B1: long problems shortened; warm-up practises dividing fractions.
Defects resolved: 3 of 3.

checks.name: Every answer recomputed
checks.detail: All 5 quiz answers checked by exact fraction arithmetic.

checks.name: Matches the standard
checks.detail: Every activity computes a unit rate from a ratio of fractions.

checks.name: Reading level
checks.detail: No word problem longer than 25 words.

approval: Approved by the maths department lead.
deliver: Lesson plan, quiz and answer key published to the grade 7 maths shared folder, tagged 7.RP.A.1.
